caption: The drawing features a single human figure performing a handstand, with the body bent in an arch so that the feet are nearly touching above the head. The person is dressed in brightly colored clothing: a yellow-green tunic with blue cuffs, red pants with yellow-green sections, and a matching yellow-green conical hat. The hands and feet are bare and colored in a natural skin tone. The figure's hair is tied in a short tail at the back of the head. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional scenery, but there are four small squares, each divided into quarters by a cross, situated around the figure. The word "TANTZER" is written in small letters beneath the figure.
title: Mechanical Toy
